name: Water3D
shortDescription: A water surface with waves for seas, lakes and rivers, where objects can float.
description: A 3D water surface for seas, lakes and rivers, with animated waves, light reflections and foam on wave crests.
- Resize it to cover a sea or a lake: waves follow its size. Put it at the Z position of the water level.
- **Make objects float** with an action (for objects with the 3D physics behavior), and check if an object is **underwater**.
- Read the height of the waves anywhere with an expression, for example to move a boat.

- Choose another **style** in the properties: realistic, ocean, cartoon, pixel art or cel-shaded water, lava, pixel magma or toxic slime. Every style, the default one included, can draw foam around objects, fade into deep water, tint the view underwater, and have pixel art and bubbles: these effects are off at 0.
- For more realistic ripples, set a seamless **normal map** of water waves in the properties.
- Works well with the 3D terrain extension: place the water between hills or around an island.

eventsBasedObjects.description: A water surface with waves, for seas, lakes and rivers. Objects can float on it.
eventsBasedObjects.name: Water3D

eventsFunctions.description: the Z position of the water surface, with the waves, at a position of the scene.

propertyDescriptors.label: Style
propertyDescriptors.description: The look of the surface. The colors, foam and effects of the other properties apply to every style.
propertyDescriptors.name: Style

propertyDescriptors.label: Opacity
propertyDescriptors.description: From 0 (invisible) to 255 (opaque).
propertyDescriptors.name: Opacity

propertyDescriptors.label: Color of wave crests
propertyDescriptors.description: Also the color of the sky reflected on the water, seen from the side.
propertyDescriptors.name: CrestColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Wave height
propertyDescriptors.description: 0 for flat water. Waves shorter than a few times the size of the water divided by 256 don't move the surface: they are only drawn with the light.
propertyDescriptors.name: WaveHeight

propertyDescriptors.label: Ripples normal map
propertyDescriptors.description: Optional. A seamless normal map of small waves, moving on the surface to reflect the light like real water.
propertyDescriptors.name: NormalMap

propertyDescriptors.label: Ripples size
propertyDescriptors.description: The size of the normal map on the surface.
propertyDescriptors.name: NormalMapSize

propertyDescriptors.label: Deep water color
propertyDescriptors.description: Color of the deep water, and of the dark parts of the pattern of the other styles.
propertyDescriptors.name: DeepColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Foam color
propertyDescriptors.description: Color of the foam around objects, of the bubbles, and of the light parts of the pattern of the other styles.
propertyDescriptors.name: FoamColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Pattern scale
propertyDescriptors.description: Size of the pattern drawn on the surface (the ripples of the default style).
propertyDescriptors.name: PatternScale

propertyDescriptors.label: Pattern speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Speed of the pattern drawn on the surface (the ripples of the default style).
propertyDescriptors.name: PatternSpeed

propertyDescriptors.label: Crest foam
propertyDescriptors.description: Foam on the crests of the waves, from 0 (no foam) to 1 (a lot).
propertyDescriptors.name: Foam

propertyDescriptors.label: Foam width
propertyDescriptors.description: Width of the foam around objects.
propertyDescriptors.name: FoamWidth

propertyDescriptors.label: Foam intensity
propertyDescriptors.description: Foam where objects cross the surface or the shore is close below it, from 0 (no foam) to 1 (solid foam).
propertyDescriptors.name: FoamIntensity

propertyDescriptors.label: Foam speed
propertyDescriptors.description: Speed of the foam around objects.
propertyDescriptors.name: FoamSpeed

propertyDescriptors.label: Underwater tint
propertyDescriptors.description: Tint of the view when the camera is under the surface, from 0 (none) to 1 (opaque).
propertyDescriptors.name: UnderwaterDensity

propertyDescriptors.label: Water density
propertyDescriptors.description: How fast what is under the surface fades out into the deep water color, per 100 pixels of water. 0 to see the bottom at any depth.
propertyDescriptors.name: WaterDensity

propertyDescriptors.label: Pixel size
propertyDescriptors.description: Size of the square pixels of the surface. 0 for no pixel art.
propertyDescriptors.name: PixelSize

propertyDescriptors.label: Animation frames per second
propertyDescriptors.description: The animation of the surface moves by steps. 0 for a smooth animation.
propertyDescriptors.name: AnimationFps

propertyDescriptors.label: Bubble intensity
propertyDescriptors.description: Bubbles swelling and popping on the surface, from 0 (no bubbles) to 1.
propertyDescriptors.name: BubbleIntensity

propertyDescriptors.label: Sharp reflections
propertyDescriptors.description: Glossier surface with pinpoint sun glints. For the default and the "Realistic water" styles.
propertyDescriptors.name: SharpReflections
